title: A pinned local filtered Hom comparison
statement: Fix a preordered index I, ring diagram R, cocone c, stage i, scheme X and s₀:X→Spec(R_i), with the scheme derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. For W⊆X and a function m:α→β of sets in universe max u w, PerfectHomLocalComparison(W,m) means the existence of an open immersion t:Y→X with range W and s=t≫s₀, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, with localized derived categories. There are perfect P,Q on Y [def-pc-perfect-complex], a functor H on the tail ≥i, a colimit cocone d with IsColimit witness, ident_j:H_j≃Hom(P_j,Q_j), and equivalences a:α≃d.pt and b:β≃Hom(P_limit,Q_limit). The identifications pin all H transitions to perfectStageMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport], and b(m(a⁻¹(d.ι_j(f))))=perfectLimitMap(ident_j(f)) for each representative. No injectivity, surjectivity or continuity is asserted. Colimits are in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
